transcript:
Client (Priya): Hi, mujhe FY25-26 ka ITR file karwana hai. CA ho na aap?
CA (Mehta): Haan, main CA hoon. Salary income hai ya business bhi?
Client: Sirf salary, ek hi employer. Form 16 hai mere paas.
CA: Theek hai, 3,000 rupees mein file kar dunga.
Client: Payment kab? Advance nahi dena, pehle acknowledgement chahiye.
CA: Theek hai. ITR-V acknowledgement milne ke baad hi payment.
Client: Aur agar notice aaya to?
CA: Notice ka reply alag se charge hoga.
Client: Theek hai, aap file kar do jaldi.
